newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romanian President Emil Constantinescu met local banking community leaders, saying that the government's planned reform programme could not succeed without a strong banking sector, in which private banks have a significant role to play.
* Romanian Orthodox Church leaders started two-day meeting to discuss role of church and its ties with Greek-Orthodox, Catholic and Protestant churches.

* Romania will align timber prices to Western levels, up from present domestic price of $1.0 per cubic metre of timber, junior minister for environment, forestry and water said during ruling National Peasant Party's weekly news conference.
